news.headline: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
news.summary: Micro1 is hitting $500M in annual revenue as AI companies race to secure high-quality training data. The startup's explosive growth reflects broader demand from enterprises building and refining large language models—a trend benefiting the entire data provisioning sector.

news.headline: MANTRA token sinks 18% to record low amid blockchain halt
news.summary: MANTRA token hit a record low as its blockchain stalled, prompting major exchanges to freeze deposits and withdrawals. The token has since recovered slightly to $0.0044, but uncertainty around the chain's status continues to weigh on investor confidence.

educational.title: The Emergency Fund Rule Nobody Follows (But Should)
points: An emergency fund is 3-6 months of essential expenses, kept in cash, not invested
It's not for vacations — it's for job loss, medical bills, or a broken car
Without one, a single bad month can force you into high-interest debt
Keep it boring: a high-yield savings account, not the stock market
Build it before investing aggressively — it's the foundation everything else sits on
